rptrs.map_info:
This repeater will initially be at my home site. We will use it to test several areas for coverage, then after the testing we will install it at the best location and update the Lat/long and antenna data. Repeater will carry 3140, and 31401 or 31402 on TS2 (the later depending on final location) 31408 OK WX will be on TS1. This is one of a group of repeaters we will be building for our severe storm coverage.
Also we are going to start using the upper part of 420 Mhz for digital (12.5Khz) repeaters. This part of the band in Oklahoma is totally abandoned and there is no activity there. So rather than be part of the cause of the loss we are looking at using it for something productive.
